findings.title: Imported HTML bypasses post sanitization
findings.body: This creates imported posts with `cook_method: raw_html`, and `Post#cook` returns their raw content without passing it through the normal rendering and sanitization pipeline. Feed item content is inserted directly into that raw content at line 13, so an RSS/Atom feed containing executable markup can create stored XSS that runs for forum visitors viewing the imported topic or embed. Sanitize the imported HTML before storing it or render it through the normal safe pipeline.

findings.title: Resize postMessage uses a full referer as its target origin
findings.body: `request.referer` is a full URL and commonly includes a path, but `postMessage`'s `targetOrigin` must be an origin (scheme, host, and optional port), not a URL with a path or query. The browser rejects this call with a `SyntaxError`, so the embed never sends its height and the parent iframe remains at its default height. Pass the referer's parsed origin instead.

findings.title: Referer is interpolated into executable JavaScript without escaping
findings.body: The request's Referer is attacker-controlled input and is inserted directly into a single-quoted JavaScript string. A crafted referer that passes the host check can break out of the string and inject script into the embed response, causing stored or reflected script execution in the forum origin for visitors loading the embed. Serialize the value with a JavaScript-safe encoder, and preferably use a parsed origin.
